$description: Mechanical mapping from primitive colour classes to the GovKit semantic colour classes for the app's own markup (T-02): the production sources of apps/app/src, packages/assistant-chat/src (rendered by the app, same release scope) and apps/docs/src, ts/tsx and CSS @apply; tests and stories are listed separately. Paths are relative to the repository root. For each file, entries list every primitive colour class occurrence in source order: `old` is the class exactly as written (variant prefix included), `new` its exact replacement (every class keeps the variant prefix of `old`) or null when the class stays, with the reason; `token` names the role-right token of an unconverted conflict; `protect: "important"` marks a replacement that adds the important modifier to keep winning an override (P-38). Built from the roles, as the kit's component map (packages/gov-ui-kit/design-system/tokens/semantic-colors.component-map.json), with the same conventions, and validated by apps/app/scripts/semanticColors/validate-app-map.mjs through real Tailwind compiles of the stylesheet entries (pnpm --filter @aragon/app colors:map:check). It lives in the app because the app owns these sources and their release; the kit's map and data stay the kit's.

applied.lines: Line numbers describe the sources at effc7327b, before applying; Biome then re-sorted and re-wrapped edited lines.

conventions: Role first, value second (P-17, P-19): a part takes a level role (primary / secondary / tertiary, solid / subtle for coloured fills) when its colour does not react to interaction, and state roles (default / hover / active / selected / disabled) when its own colour changes on hover, press, focus or selection on the same element. Converted only if that token's default-theme value is exactly today's colour; otherwise the class stays, with the role-right token in `token` (conflict).

Static text: text/surface/primary = neutral-800, secondary = neutral-500, tertiary = neutral-400; status text text/<status>/primary = *-800; blue static text text/accent/primary. Static containers: bg/surface/primary (neutral-0) with border/surface/secondary (neutral-100, P-29); grey wells and code blocks bg/surface/secondary; 1px fill dividers bg/surface/tertiary (Figma binds dividers to bg/surface/tertiary).

Icons (an <Icon>, an svg, an icon class prop) take the icon family: static grey icons icon/surface/primary (400) or secondary (300); status icons icon/<status>/primary (500). The Aragon logo and mark are brand art: icon/brand/primary; the white logo on the brand-blue hero icon/accent/inverse.

Pressables: a part whose colour changes on hover / press uses default / hover / active; a focused field is active (kit convention); keyboard highlight is hover; a focus-ring-<colour> becomes `focus-ring ring-<group>-focus` (P-20). Text links use the link family (text/link/default / hover / active, neutral links text/link/secondary-*); a current page is selected.

Content on an accent or brand fill (initials on the accent disc, the launcher icon, the explore hero title) takes the inverse role: text/accent/inverse. The Aragon brand surfaces (explore hero, explore bar after the hero, docs banner) take bg/brand/solid and gradient/brand/primary: identity, not interaction.

Gradient fades take the gradient tokens (gradient/surface/primary = page grey, secondary = white, brand/primary); carets the kit's input caret (caret-bg-surface-secondary-inverse) or an accent text token through caret-.

Not converted: per-DAO page headers drawn over the DAO's own artwork (`brand`: brand art is not themed); opacity-modified classes (`no-utility`: semantic utilities are static and take no modifier); shadow sizes the semantic layer lacks (lg, xl: `no-token`); a class that generates no CSS (`no-css`); a class whose rename would change which class wins on its element or inside the component it is passed to (`ordering`).

Ordering (P-26/P-27, P-37…P-40): Tailwind orders utilities by its own sort, so renaming can change which of two classes on one element wins. The validator compiles every class involved and compares the winner (by !important, specificity, then position) of every same-property pair on one element, in the file and across a className passed into another component (kit or app). Pairs that can never meet are listed in orderingReviewed with the reason.

aliasCandidates.$description: How many unconverted classes a component-level alias token (P-51 pattern: `<property>/<group>/<aliased role>-<component>`, today's colour in the default theme, the aliased token's values in "next" and "dark") would unblock, grouped by the role-right token it would alias, with today's values. Not created in this pass (decision OPEN, see the decisions file).
